releases.notes:
# Voyage Core 0.1.1

Minecraft 1.20.1 / Fabric Loader 0.16.9. Early-development release.

This release establishes the launcher-managed update channel. The JAR includes
the existing Voyage HUD, key display, CPS, sprint, zoom and launcher configuration
bridge. A compatible launcher checks `client-manifest.json`, verifies SHA-256 and
the Fabric mod identity, and keeps the previous Core JAR outside the mods folder.

The release is not a port to Minecraft 1.21. Other launcher versions/profiles can
use third-party Fabric mods without Voyage Core. Microsoft authentication in the
launcher remains unfinished; this is not a production-ready client release.

## Release procedure

1. Update `mod_version` in `gradle.properties`.
2. Run `gradlew build` using JDK 17 and `node scripts/release-manifest.mjs`.
3. Test the remapped JAR, then push the matching `v<version>` tag.
4. The release workflow prepares a draft with the JAR and compatibility/hash
   manifest. Review and publish it together; never replace a published artifact.

For incompatible Minecraft/loader changes, maintain the previous compatible
release in the launcher bundle. Current launchers ignore incompatible manifests.
